name: SaveInCloud Nuvion
line: Provision virtual machines and manage their operating systems yourself.

free.text: R$200 credit for 30 days; a 14-day trial is also advertised

cells.selfhost: Yes; manage the guest OS and apps

work.math: R$45.33 for the VM + R$5.50 for volume + R$20.44 for an IPv4 address = R$71.27 base. Add R$0 to R$24 for data sent out. Free-traffic claims conflict. The boot disk, domain, HTTPS certificate and tax are not priced.
R$71.27 base. 100 GB of data sent out adds R$0 to R$24 if charged. The price for 1 vCPU and 1 GB is published, but throughput and build use are untested. The boot disk and tax are not priced.

R$92.35 VM + R$7.70 volumes + R$20.44 IPv4 + R$1.80 backup = R$122.29. Seven 10 GB copies (assumed) use R$12.60. Data out adds R$0 to R$24. Backup size, boot disk and tax: unknown. 10 GB private database traffic is free.
